capabilities.justification: Reads the contract crate's vos.toml and warrant/lemmas.sat (bounded, regular files only, never a symlink); the rest goes through vos-link's loader.
gen writes exactly warrant/lemmas.sat (refusing a symlink); check --emit-drat writes the .cnf and .drat of each obligation into the directory the caller names (no `..`, never over a symlink).
Reads the command-line arguments (the contract crate directory and --root).
Prints the cross-check, gen and check reports to standard output and a no-verdict reason to standard error.
Reported by the analyzer for std::process::ExitCode, which only sets the exit status; the program spawns no process.
Runs the Warrant evaluator on threads with a 256 MiB stack (as vos-link does) and the ten mutant documents in parallel; every thread is joined before its result is used.

justification: A host checker: reads one contract package through vos-link's bounded loader (that crate owns the file access), evaluates it, and prints a report. No network, no subprocess, no writes.
